name: Solugen
long_description: Solugen is decarbonizing the chemistry of everyday life with enzymes and innovative metal catalysts. Our new to the world Bioforge platform technology can produce high value chemical goods that are biobased and carbon negative, at cost on par with current technologies. We are making sustainable chemistry accessible to all living things, to ensure a prosperous world exists for generations.

question_answers.question: How did your company get started? (i.e., How did the founders meet? How did you come up with the idea? How did you decide to be a founder?)
question_answers.answer: A poker game led to the creation of the company when G and Sean realized they were both working on the decarbonization of chemicals but from completely different angles. They joined forces to create the worlds leading decarbonization technology platform.

question_answers.question: What is the core problem you are solving? Why is this a big problem? What made you decide to work on it?
question_answers.answer: Chemicals production generates over 8% of all GHG emissions, either from energy use or the chemical reactions themselves. Solugen’s technology allows the world to produce these chemical ingredients from renewable sources in a carbon negative manner, on par with the cost of current incumbent products.

question_answers.question: What is your long-term vision? If you truly succeed, what will be different about the world?
question_answers.answer: 1 million mini-mill Bioforges producing all of the basic chemical building blocks the world needs, from recycled waste streams like carboard.

founders.title: Founder/CTO
founders.founder_bio:
Sean Hunt is the co-founder and CTO of Solugen, Inc., a renewable chemicals company based in
Houston, TX. All things chemical engineering and process technology development, scaleup, manufacturing, commercialization.
